approvalContract: A change needs a named reviewer, date, meaning and approved FR/EN/AR wording in the same change. Review role and money semantics before literal parity. Owner or manager resolves disputed terminology. Approval covers only the listed terms, never the entire interface. A booking is not a payment; fixed is not tested; departure is not settlement. Do not claim native-speaker certification without that review.
